aldra/cracked_not_broken_torvald_c73e5da.speaker: aldra
aldra/cracked_not_broken_torvald_c73e5da.text: Cracked. Not broken. Torvald will hear of this.

aldra/he_only_looked_at_665606c4.speaker: aldra
aldra/he_only_looked_at_665606c4.text: He only looked at the ridge. Then he went back.

aldra/hold_the_rime_when_a0531061.speaker: aldra
aldra/hold_the_rime_when_a0531061.text: Hold the rime. When the green stops beating, the wood is ours.

aldra/rime_on_the_ramp_42787a6c.speaker: aldra
aldra/rime_on_the_ramp_42787a6c.text: Rime on the ramp, Torvald. They will not climb it twice.

aldra/the_green_has_stopped_ac1b55c9.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_green_has_stopped_ac1b55c9.text: The green has stopped. Winter keeps this wood now.

aldra/the_old_storm_sword_95684d1b.speaker: aldra
aldra/the_old_storm_sword_95684d1b.text: The old storm-sword crossed the river twice today.

aldra/through_my_glass_already_f0cbd6ee.speaker: aldra
aldra/through_my_glass_already_f0cbd6ee.text: Through my glass already? Go, then. The mere remembers every footstep.

aldra/winter_goes_home_torvald_953915fe.speaker: aldra
aldra/winter_goes_home_torvald_953915fe.text: Winter goes home, Torvald. Let the Bishop dig his own grave.

ashby/a_masters_forge_my_ca56e44a.speaker: ashby
ashby/a_masters_forge_my_ca56e44a.text: A Master's forge! My grandad would weep. Then he'd charge you for it.

ashby/built_you_a_tower_51b9f1fe.speaker: ashby
ashby/built_you_a_tower_51b9f1fe.text: Built you a tower on the west road, my queen. Learned that at the Millwatch.

ashby/emberguard_boots_on_we_41d6a1ed.speaker: ashby
ashby/emberguard_boots_on_we_41d6a1ed.text: Emberguard! Boots on! We march at first light!

ashby/first_batch_out_of_2ebdc632.speaker: ashby
ashby/first_batch_out_of_2ebdc632.text: First batch out of the old forge, my queen! Blades that remember the fire.

ashby/my_queen_work_crews_2b047376.speaker: ashby
ashby/my_queen_work_crews_2b047376.text: My queen! Work crew's on the stair. Find us a hearth to build around!

ashby/rider_at_the_gate_f3c9142f.speaker: ashby
ashby/rider_at_the_gate_f3c9142f.text: Rider at the gate! Make way!

ashby/shades_sitting_on_millstone_729117.speaker: ashby
ashby/shades_sitting_on_millstone_729117.text: Shades sitting on Millstone Cross, my queen. No caravan's getting through there.

ashby/shadow_at_the_camp_6531003e.speaker: ashby
ashby/shadow_at_the_camp_6531003e.text: Shadow at the camp, my queen! We'll hold the hall. Go!

ashby/the_emberwatch_is_burning_7a9e83ae.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_emberwatch_is_burning_7a9e83ae.text: The Emberwatch is burning! Fall back, fall back!

ashby/the_forge_is_lost_082ed9e1.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_forge_is_lost_082ed9e1.text: The forge is lost! The hearth's gone cold!

ashby/the_saltwatch_is_lost_b481ccd1.speaker: ashby
ashby/the_saltwatch_is_lost_b481ccd1.text: The Saltwatch is lost! Get the queen out!

ashby/up_up_shadow_in_7a36b5e0.speaker: ashby
ashby/up_up_shadow_in_7a36b5e0.text: Up! Up! Shadow in the camp! Torches, all of you!

ashby/watchtowers_ours_my_queen_dd96ac81.speaker: ashby
ashby/watchtowers_ours_my_queen_dd96ac81.text: Watchtower's ours, my queen. We can see clear across the Hollowmere.

bettany/arrows_mostly_and_never_aa9c45aa.speaker: bettany
bettany/arrows_mostly_and_never_aa9c45aa.text: Arrows, mostly. And never having to go down there again.

bettany/eight_magpies_the_lodge_31433e94.speaker: bettany
bettany/eight_magpies_the_lodge_31433e94.text: Eight Magpies. The Lodge remembers who clears its road.

bettany/guides_are_with_you_e70f4481.speaker: bettany
bettany/guides_are_with_you_e70f4481.text: Guides are with you. Go before the Bishop buys the next one.

bettany/halfway_the_old_hunters_f6dbe445.speaker: bettany
bettany/halfway_the_old_hunters_f6dbe445.text: Halfway. The old hunters are starting to like you. Don't let it go to your head.

bettany/heads_up_firelady_the_940c22c7.speaker: bettany
bettany/heads_up_firelady_the_940c22c7.text: Heads up, Firelady. The Magpies are out. They like their caravans full and their guards absent.

bettany/it_did_the_lodge_b9bed1ca.speaker: bettany
bettany/it_did_the_lodge_b9bed1ca.text: It did. The Lodge pays better, and nobody here throws fire at the furniture.

bettany/mind_the_flags_firelady_0c85d80d.speaker: bettany
bettany/mind_the_flags_firelady_0c85d80d.text: Mind the flags, Firelady. Coin on a flag is the only order that lot understands.

bettany/one_wagon_five_to_27f8f10b.speaker: bettany
bettany/one_wagon_five_to_27f8f10b.text: One wagon. Five to go. The hunters count slow and they count twice.

bettany/six_paid_in_full_b206ca67.speaker: bettany
bettany/six_paid_in_full_b206ca67.text: Six. Paid in full. Here's your road down: a stair under Emberfall, the Sunrise Road.

bettany/the_crooked_lantern_is_5d905cc1.speaker: bettany
bettany/the_crooked_lantern_is_5d905cc1.text: The Crooked Lantern is open! Sellswords, cheap ale, no questions. First hire's on the house.

bettany/two_of_ours_will_8082354f.speaker: bettany
bettany/two_of_ours_will_8082354f.text: Two of ours will guide you. Nobody else has walked it since the Master.

dancer/come_on_my_queen_d768fe5e.speaker: dancer
dancer/come_on_my_queen_d768fe5e.text: Come on, my queen! One dance!

hush/and_the_people_in_38bfd736.speaker: hush
hush/and_the_people_in_38bfd736.text: And the people in the tents, Bishop?

hush/another_night_little_queen_cf1af060.speaker: hush
hush/another_night_little_queen_cf1af060.text: Another night, little queen. There is always another night.

hush/did_you_miss_me_4ed8c8cb.speaker: hush
hush/did_you_miss_me_4ed8c8cb.text: Did you miss me, little ember? I missed you. Twice now.

hush/four_the_camp_will_8abdeae8.speaker: hush
hush/four_the_camp_will_8abdeae8.text: Four. The camp will wake hungry, Bishop.

hush/hold_still_little_queen_e14afc20.speaker: hush
hush/hold_still_little_queen_e14afc20.text: Hold still, little queen. It's kinder.

hush/hush_now_the_dark_083469dc.speaker: hush
hush/hush_now_the_dark_083469dc.text: Hush now. The dark only wants to be listened to.

hush/light_it_bishop_just_2e5a0a38.speaker: hush
hush/light_it_bishop_just_2e5a0a38.text: Light it, Bishop. Just this once.

hush/old_man_you_still_ebc88833.speaker: hush
hush/old_man_you_still_ebc88833.text: Old man. You still owe me a night.

hush/once_is_enough_to_4025d01e.speaker: hush
hush/once_is_enough_to_4025d01e.text: Once is enough to remember, Bishop. Who is it tonight?

hush/one_horn_fewer_the_b84447ea.speaker: hush
hush/one_horn_fewer_the_b84447ea.text: One horn fewer. The valley will have to shout.

hush/one_wagon_its_wheels_a0dd3082.speaker: hush
hush/one_wagon_its_wheels_a0dd3082.text: One wagon. Its wheels will not turn again.

hush/riders_at_the_reeds_637ae179.speaker: hush
hush/riders_at_the_reeds_637ae179.text: Riders at the reeds. Quick little sparks.

hush/the_knife_bends_not_c5154be6.speaker: hush
hush/the_knife_bends_not_c5154be6.text: The knife bends... Not tonight. Not...

hush/the_little_ember_in_80809961.speaker: hush
hush/the_little_ember_in_80809961.text: The little ember, in the dark. You're a long way from your braziers.

hush/the_old_man_awake_880df431.speaker: hush
hush/the_old_man_awake_880df431.text: The old man. Awake, of course. He was awake that night too.

hush/the_old_man_bites_731539db.speaker: hush
hush/the_old_man_bites_731539db.text: The old man bites. How charming.

hush/then_they_can_lie_dd75e0d4.speaker: hush
hush/then_they_can_lie_dd75e0d4.text: Then they can lie down again. I'll help them.

hush/there_is_always_another_5a290e4e.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_5a290e4e.text: There is always another night, little ember. Another night.

hush/there_is_always_another_f7fb47ef.speaker: hush
hush/there_is_always_another_f7fb47ef.text: There is always another night, Bishop.

hush/there_she_sleeps_the_73b03a6b.speaker: hush
hush/there_she_sleeps_the_73b03a6b.text: There she sleeps. The little queen. One step, Bishop. Just one.

hush/whatever_moves_bishop_and_c666e91b.speaker: hush
hush/whatever_moves_bishop_and_c666e91b.text: Whatever moves, Bishop. And a few things that don't.

maelis/stumpwood_breathes_again_the_c386.speaker: maelis
maelis/stumpwood_breathes_again_the_c386.text: Stumpwood breathes again. The forest remembers who froze it.

maelis/turn_back_fire_child_b04181ab.speaker: maelis
maelis/turn_back_fire_child_b04181ab.text: Turn back, fire-child. The wolves already have your scent.

malrik/a_gardener_and_a_7eb3ea3b.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_gardener_and_a_7eb3ea3b.text: A gardener and a matchstick. Torvald, they are planting trees at us.

malrik/a_giant_made_of_5fb6ef9b.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_giant_made_of_5fb6ef9b.text: A giant made of rubble, in MY war? Shades, kill the pillars. Then kill Vessa.

malrik/a_little_less_than_e9db75b8.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_little_less_than_e9db75b8.text: A little. Less than you would think.

malrik/a_map_to_the_5b99da9c.speaker: malrik
malrik/a_map_to_the_5b99da9c.text: A map to the deep. How generous. I'll take it off your body.

malrik/an_old_man_and_16acc110.speaker: malrik
malrik/an_old_man_and_16acc110.text: An old man and a thunderstorm. Shades, fall back. I'll collect whatever is left.

malrik/and_every_one_of_e9f01242.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_every_one_of_e9f01242.text: And every one of them is mine.

malrik/and_me_he_gave_ad0ff01f.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_me_he_gave_ad0ff01f.text: And me? He gave me what was left over. The dark. As if it were a kindness.

malrik/and_you_brought_fire_4350d292.speaker: malrik
malrik/and_you_brought_fire_4350d292.text: And you brought fire to a meadow. We all have our gifts, Vessa.

malrik/at_an_armys_supper_a3673f23.speaker: malrik
malrik/at_an_armys_supper_a3673f23.text: At an army's supper, Torvald. Hungry soldiers go home.

malrik/bring_me_back_their_59d08381.speaker: malrik
malrik/bring_me_back_their_59d08381.text: Bring me back their axle pins.

malrik/crack_do_you_hear_138941bb.speaker: malrik
malrik/crack_do_you_hear_138941bb.text: Crack. Do you hear it, Vessa? That is the sound of a lock giving up.

malrik/dying_in_the_dark_fb135b2c.speaker: malrik
malrik/dying_in_the_dark_fb135b2c.text: Dying in the dark. Twice in one war. I am starting to keep count.

malrik/even_the_bishops_of_bb562140.speaker: malrik
malrik/even_the_bishops_of_bb562140.text: Even the bishops. Of course even the bishops.

malrik/even_thunder_falls_off_e2b72826.speaker: malrik
malrik/even_thunder_falls_off_e2b72826.text: Even thunder falls off a horse, old man.

malrik/every_road_charges_a_48b23a8d.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_road_charges_a_48b23a8d.text: Every road charges a toll, Vessa. This one charges you.

malrik/every_vigil_out_at_11f98382.speaker: malrik
malrik/every_vigil_out_at_11f98382.text: Every vigil out at once. Someone has been very rude to my dead.

malrik/everyone_tells_my_story_b15bf545.speaker: malrik
malrik/everyone_tells_my_story_b15bf545.text: Everyone tells my story wrong. Let me try.

malrik/everything_old_man_i_49ece533.speaker: malrik
malrik/everything_old_man_i_49ece533.text: Everything, old man. I took it all. That is the whole secret.

malrik/feed_old_stone_take_42ea4b5b.speaker: malrik
malrik/feed_old_stone_take_42ea4b5b.text: Feed, old stone. Take what you need from me. I have plenty.

malrik/ford_mud_my_father_60cd5c23.speaker: malrik
malrik/ford_mud_my_father_60cd5c23.text: Ford mud. My father said the same of grave clay: it never comes off.

malrik/four_wagons_hush_grain_95e6dc4e.speaker: malrik
malrik/four_wagons_hush_grain_95e6dc4e.text: Four wagons, Hush. Grain, arrows, oil, fodder. Hungry armies march slowly.

malrik/go_on_then_run_d5638b5a.speaker: malrik
malrik/go_on_then_run_d5638b5a.text: Go on, then. Run ahead. I'll be right behind you, with the key you lack.

malrik/good_come_home_bring_4f690a73.speaker: malrik
malrik/good_come_home_bring_4f690a73.text: Good. Come home. Bring the night with you.

malrik/good_evening_vessa_mind_c8c23dd1.speaker: malrik
malrik/good_evening_vessa_mind_c8c23dd1.text: Good evening, Vessa. Mind the statue. It's been waiting a hundred years to stretch its legs.

malrik/he_had_one_he_6b073ea7.speaker: malrik
malrik/he_had_one_he_6b073ea7.text: He had one. He wore it out honestly.

malrik/he_is_laughing_why_3b87ec97.speaker: malrik
malrik/he_is_laughing_why_3b87ec97.text: He is laughing. Why is he laughing?

malrik/hush_the_old_man_365a3fae.speaker: malrik
malrik/hush_the_old_man_365a3fae.text: Hush. The old man is with her. Wake the stones before he does.

malrik/i_did_not_ask_8e6eb56a.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_did_not_ask_8e6eb56a.text: I did not ask you anything.

malrik/i_have_heard_stop_28b1860c.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_have_heard_stop_28b1860c.text: I have heard “stop” all my life.

malrik/i_have_heard_stop_6b5d1395.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_have_heard_stop_6b5d1395.text: I have heard "stop" all my life.

malrik/i_kept_something_a_95e665a5.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_kept_something_a_95e665a5.text: I kept something. A candle. A knife. A stone that still beats in my hand.

malrik/i_sent_her_to_1effb834.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_sent_her_to_1effb834.text: I sent her to the wagons. You should be flattered she skipped your tent.

malrik/i_took_the_dark_7ada4fa9.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_took_the_dark_7ada4fa9.text: I took the dark and taught it to kneel. I took knives, and a woman who never misses.

malrik/i_was_a_gravediggers_c1b95674.speaker: malrik
malrik/i_was_a_gravediggers_c1b95674.text: I was a gravedigger's son. I grew up among the dead. They were better company.

malrik/if_i_cant_have_19d09d54.speaker: malrik
malrik/if_i_cant_have_19d09d54.text: If I can't have the deep road, nobody walks it. Burn the market.

malrik/it_is_me_torvald_03cb4e80.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_is_me_torvald_03cb4e80.text: It is me, Torvald. It has always been me.

malrik/it_knows_everyones_name_fd543fb1.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_knows_everyones_name_fd543fb1.text: It knows everyone's name. It is a stone with nothing else to do.

malrik/it_never_is_that_ed60c05e.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_never_is_that_ed60c05e.text: It never is. That is what I like about you.

malrik/it_whispers_let_it_f35c4d4b.speaker: malrik
malrik/it_whispers_let_it_f35c4d4b.text: It whispers. Let it. I am the one who listens, and I am the one who decides.

malrik/keep_it_warm_for_3523ab04.speaker: malrik
malrik/keep_it_warm_for_3523ab04.text: Keep it warm for me. The other three will come for it now.

malrik/keep_your_door_vessa_f658e6ec.speaker: malrik
malrik/keep_your_door_vessa_f658e6ec.text: Keep your door, Vessa. I have the key, and all the time in the world.

malrik/knights_to_the_shrine_e1873784.speaker: malrik
malrik/knights_to_the_shrine_e1873784.text: Knights, to the shrine glade. Burn whatever grew there twice.

malrik/light_all_the_candles_d4719180.speaker: malrik
malrik/light_all_the_candles_d4719180.text: Light all the candles you like. The dark just gets a better view.

malrik/little_vessa_you_came_e419427c.speaker: malrik
malrik/little_vessa_you_came_e419427c.text: Little Vessa. You came a long way to lose something you never had.

malrik/look_at_it_the_489223a3.speaker: malrik
malrik/look_at_it_the_489223a3.text: Look at it. The last green country. Flowers to the knee. The Master's garden.

malrik/mine_thank_you_for_88f1ef17.speaker: malrik
malrik/mine_thank_you_for_88f1ef17.text: Mine. Thank you for the escort, little ember.

malrik/more_diggers_more_knives_2ca08bff.speaker: malrik
malrik/more_diggers_more_knives_2ca08bff.text: More diggers, more knives. You should have burned my hall when you had the chance.

malrik/not_today_today_i_c27aa9a4.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_today_today_i_c27aa9a4.text: Not today. Today I have a knife.

malrik/not_tonight_tonight_we_8a9dc5fc.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_tonight_tonight_we_8a9dc5fc.text: Not tonight. Tonight we starve them. Knives are for another night.

malrik/not_who_what_four_ce853308.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_who_what_four_ce853308.text: Not who. What. Four wagons on the south hill, one token each.

malrik/not_yet_not_while_cce07bfb.speaker: malrik
malrik/not_yet_not_while_cce07bfb.text: Not yet. Not while it is listening.

malrik/old_man_they_told_90dc11f1.speaker: malrik
malrik/old_man_they_told_90dc11f1.text: Old man. They told me you were dead. I was almost sad.

malrik/one_pillar_down_youre_dda66a45.speaker: malrik
malrik/one_pillar_down_youre_dda66a45.text: One pillar down. You're welcome, little ember. Don't get used to it.

malrik/open_it_mason_let_c67d4853.speaker: malrik
malrik/open_it_mason_let_c67d4853.text: Open it, Mason. Let me see what the Master was so busy guarding.

malrik/out_out_i_decide_ca190619.speaker: malrik
malrik/out_out_i_decide_ca190619.text: Out. OUT. I decide. I have always decided.

malrik/patience_was_never_my_17e564fd.speaker: malrik
malrik/patience_was_never_my_17e564fd.text: Patience was never my virtue. Luckily, I brought shovels.

malrik/put_it_down_that_da2e3fa9.speaker: malrik
malrik/put_it_down_that_da2e3fa9.text: Put it down. That crown was never meant for someone who throws fire at her problems.

malrik/rubble_with_eyes_your_191649c8.speaker: malrik
malrik/rubble_with_eyes_your_191649c8.text: Rubble with eyes. Your mess, Vessa. I'll be at my camp, enjoying the view.

malrik/she_missed_emberfall_then_fbb0540.speaker: malrik
malrik/she_missed_emberfall_then_fbb0540.text: She missed. Emberfall. Then the Hollow. I lost, and lost, and every time I lost,

malrik/sleep_you_did_your_12da7ef3.speaker: malrik
malrik/sleep_you_did_your_12da7ef3.text: Sleep. You did your share of standing.

malrik/someone_burned_my_barracks_41a810.speaker: malrik
malrik/someone_burned_my_barracks_41a810.text: Someone burned my barracks, so I brought fewer friends. Petty, little ember. I approve.

malrik/stand_with_me_hush_af4b0136.speaker: malrik
malrik/stand_with_me_hush_af4b0136.text: Stand with me, Hush. In daylight, for once.

malrik/struck_down_at_sunrise_b828d22f.speaker: malrik
malrik/struck_down_at_sunrise_b828d22f.text: Struck down at sunrise. How very Vessa.

malrik/struck_down_by_an_15035031.speaker: malrik
malrik/struck_down_by_an_15035031.text: Struck down... by an old man's weather.

malrik/tell_me_to_stop_e48f86d6.speaker: malrik
malrik/tell_me_to_stop_e48f86d6.text: Tell me to stop again tomorrow, Ysolde. I will not stop.

malrik/that_bell_he_rang_dbaa4cd0.speaker: malrik
malrik/that_bell_he_rang_dbaa4cd0.text: That bell. He rang it every dusk. Stop wearing my father's bell.

malrik/that_is_how_a_dfbf8c00.speaker: malrik
malrik/that_is_how_a_dfbf8c00.text: That is how a gravedigger's son grows strong: he never puts the shovel down.

malrik/the_dead_are_up_84123962.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_dead_are_up_84123962.text: The dead are up, Hush. My dead.

malrik/the_ford_is_mine_a16120be.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ford_is_mine_a16120be.text: The ford is mine. Write it down, Ysolde. You like things that last.

malrik/the_ford_is_mine_beebbaa5.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ford_is_mine_beebbaa5.text: The ford is mine. The tree is not. Not today.

malrik/the_master_found_me_68a72082.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_master_found_me_68a72082.text: The Master found me reading tombstones by one candle. He said: this one, too.

malrik/the_ridge_is_mine_ebd65d79.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_ridge_is_mine_ebd65d79.text: The ridge is mine. The valley next. I will not stop.

malrik/the_shrine_glade_how_c74a206b.speaker: malrik
malrik/the_shrine_glade_how_c74a206b.text: The shrine glade. How fitting. Do pray, Ysolde. Nobody answered last time.

malrik/then_do_not_wake_124d2124.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_do_not_wake_124d2124.text: Then do not wake him further. Be the quiet thing in the dark.

malrik/then_he_vanished_and_877f4086.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_he_vanished_and_877f4086.text: Then he vanished and left us nothing. So I took. That is the whole secret.

malrik/then_the_living_stay_af34c0b4.speaker: malrik
malrik/then_the_living_stay_af34c0b4.text: Then the living stay in the crypt, and the dead go back to bed.

malrik/they_will_stand_there_52f7eb60.speaker: malrik
malrik/they_will_stand_there_52f7eb60.text: They will stand there and tell me to stop. Fire. Roots. An old man's storm.

malrik/three_relics_little_ember_f629f2a.speaker: malrik
malrik/three_relics_little_ember_f629f2a.text: Three relics, little ember. Hand them over and I'll let you keep the hat.

malrik/too_fourth_of_four_de85a128.speaker: malrik
malrik/too_fourth_of_four_de85a128.text: Too. Fourth of four. Fire was his joy, ice his patience, the wood his heart.

malrik/torvald_now_both_bridges_9a488586.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_now_both_bridges_9a488586.text: Torvald, now. Both bridges. Let them choose which kingdom to lose.

malrik/torvald_the_east_bank_0f158a86.speaker: malrik
malrik/torvald_the_east_bank_0f158a86.text: Torvald, the east bank is yours. I will take the water. Hush, take whatever moves.

malrik/two_ysolde_will_count_632abf53.speaker: malrik
malrik/two_ysolde_will_count_632abf53.text: Two. Ysolde will count her sacks at dawn and come up short.

malrik/useful_do_not_get_30113307.speaker: malrik
malrik/useful_do_not_get_30113307.text: Useful. Do not get comfortable in there.

malrik/vessa_have_you_noticed_99b77995.speaker: malrik
malrik/vessa_have_you_noticed_99b77995.text: Vessa. Have you noticed whose side the winter is on now?

malrik/wagons_not_tents_i_5e634377.speaker: malrik
malrik/wagons_not_tents_i_5e634377.text: Wagons. Not tents. I grew up burying people who starved in tents.

malrik/you_can_help_by_563a0e83.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_can_help_by_563a0e83.text: You can help by being quiet. Stones are usually good at that.

malrik/you_raised_my_dead_6b92f487.speaker: malrik
malrik/you_raised_my_dead_6b92f487.text: You raised my dead, and now you sell me the shovel.

master/all_four_of_you_02b63bbb.speaker: master
master/all_four_of_you_02b63bbb.text: All four of you, or none.

master/armies_have_not_broken_946bc99e.speaker: master
master/armies_have_not_broken_946bc99e.text: Armies have not broken him, nor winters, nor time.

master/burn_her_forest_down_16f3dda5.speaker: master
master/burn_her_forest_down_16f3dda5.text: Burn her forest down, and it grows back. Every spring. Every time.

master/but_he_is_never_adfcea4c.speaker: master
master/but_he_is_never_adfcea4c.text: But he is never full. Whatever he holds, he wants more.

master/but_he_waits_too_7019f3d6.speaker: master
master/but_he_waits_too_7019f3d6.text: But he waits too long, and trusts slow ice more than quick friends.

master/but_she_never_waits_a66dd99c.speaker: master
master/but_she_never_waits_a66dd99c.text: But she never waits. And fire that will not wait burns its own house.

master/but_she_will_not_f0c2364f.speaker: master
master/but_she_will_not_f0c2364f.text: But she will not take a side, not even while the world burns.

master/dragons_great_and_small_d6939132.speaker: master
master/dragons_great_and_small_d6939132.text: Dragons great and small filled its sky, and not one breathed in anger.

master/give_her_a_wall_e312dd45.speaker: master
master/give_her_a_wall_e312dd45.text: Give her a wall, and she will burn a door through it.

master/he_raised_four_apprentices_1eed79.speaker: master
master/he_raised_four_apprentices_1eed79.text: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of them a kingdom.

master/he_thinks_i_gave_10970b83.speaker: master
master/he_thinks_i_gave_10970b83.text: He thinks I gave him leftovers. I gave the dark to the one it could not frighten.

master/his_citadel_rose_above_2e36d77d.speaker: master
master/his_citadel_rose_above_2e36d77d.text: His citadel rose above the clouds, a city of towers, bridges and bells.

master/i_cannot_open_it_0f91d8be.speaker: master
master/i_cannot_open_it_0f91d8be.text: I cannot open it. If I let go, what is under me comes up.

master/i_know_this_tale_705bd7cd.speaker: master
master/i_know_this_tale_705bd7cd.text: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.

master/i_left_him_my_5d4b36a7.speaker: master
master/i_left_him_my_5d4b36a7.text: I left him my coldest secret. Torvald was my patience.

master/i_loved_all_four_d534ea63.speaker: master
master/i_loved_all_four_d534ea63.text: I loved all four of them. And still, they went to war.

master/i_would_say_show_1f5d14b4.speaker: master
master/i_would_say_show_1f5d14b4.text: I would say: show me again. And she always did. Ysolde was my heart.

master/it_takes_four_hands_2c5a3429.speaker: master
master/it_takes_four_hands_2c5a3429.text: It takes four hands to turn this lock.

master/kings_brought_him_their_38ebe69c.speaker: master
master/kings_brought_him_their_38ebe69c.text: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home as friends.

master/malrik_i_found_him_915e2c7f.speaker: master
master/malrik_i_found_him_915e2c7f.text: Malrik. I found him reading tombstones by the light of one candle.

master/my_joy_you_came_4435f304.speaker: master
master/my_joy_you_came_4435f304.text: My joy. You came all this way.

master/nothing_is_hidden_from_3efbf049.speaker: master
master/nothing_is_hidden_from_3efbf049.text: Nothing is hidden from him. The dark itself comes when he calls.

master/once_upon_a_time_8b62d3e8.speaker: master
master/once_upon_a_time_8b62d3e8.text: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard who ever lived ruled the world.

master/still_she_laughed_like_57d11b3e.speaker: master
master/still_she_laughed_like_57d11b3e.text: Still, she laughed like sunrise. Vessa was my joy.

master/then_between_one_breath_72b919e2.speaker: master
master/then_between_one_breath_72b919e2.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

master/they_called_him_only_31069c93.speaker: master
master/they_called_him_only_31069c93.text: They called him only the Master. For a thousand years, he kept the peace.

master/torvald_the_eldest_where_f5a25caa.speaker: master
master/torvald_the_eldest_where_f5a25caa.text: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice holds, and so does the line.

master/vessa_the_youngest_she_0f7ca4c7.speaker: master
master/vessa_the_youngest_she_0f7ca4c7.text: Vessa, the youngest. She lit her first spark before she could spell her name.

master/ysolde_i_found_her_85d2e563.speaker: master
master/ysolde_i_found_her_85d2e563.text: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through the frost.

messenger/all_of_it_i_dea99842.speaker: messenger
messenger/all_of_it_i_dea99842.text: All of it. I saw it burn.

messenger/frost_on_the_road_3b83ebb9.speaker: messenger
messenger/frost_on_the_road_3b83ebb9.text: Frost on the road! They're going for the Heartseed!

messenger/she_said_remember_she_80a331e3.speaker: messenger
messenger/she_said_remember_she_80a331e3.text: She said... remember. She warned you.

messenger/thats_everyone_who_could_2b05a.speaker: messenger
messenger/thats_everyone_who_could_2b05a.text: That's everyone who could still walk.

messenger/the_ember_queen_which_0214be28.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_ember_queen_which_0214be28.text: The Ember Queen? Which one is...

messenger/the_hearts_slowing_please_4543.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_hearts_slowing_please_4543.text: The heart's slowing! Please don't let it stop!

messenger/the_heartwood_is_past_e8569950.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_heartwood_is_past_e8569950.text: The Heartwood is past the old tree. She's inside it.

messenger/the_heartwoods_down_but_7054cf.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_heartwoods_down_but_7054cf.text: The Heartwood's down! But we're still with you!

messenger/the_shadows_in_the_521a96cb.speaker: messenger
messenger/the_shadows_in_the_521a96cb.text: The Shadow's in the camp! Wake up!

messenger/weve_lost_too_many_3aa0603f.speaker: messenger
messenger/weve_lost_too_many_3aa0603f.text: We've lost too many carriers. The seed's running out.

messenger/youre_alive_go_south_50077fa7.speaker: messenger
messenger/youre_alive_go_south_50077fa7.text: You're alive! Go south, follow the red banners!

narrator/a_hundred_years_the_e560f172.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_hundred_years_the_e560f172.text: A hundred years the jailer stood over the door. Tonight Malrik's stone told it to open it.

narrator/a_quiet_field_something_49af4d7.speaker: narrator
narrator/a_quiet_field_something_49af4d7.text: A quiet field. Something is about to happen.

narrator/across_the_river_the_5b1fd132.speaker: narrator
narrator/across_the_river_the_5b1fd132.text: Across the river, the Lark horns call the whole valley to arms.

narrator/and_for_the_first_887ec3c4.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_for_the_first_887ec3c4.text: And for the first time in twelve years, the Sunrise Road saw its sunrise.

narrator/and_found_the_last_d595ceab.speaker: narrator
narrator/and_found_the_last_d595ceab.text: and found the last green country: Evenmead.

narrator/crown_hollow_where_the_6aaed2b2.speaker: narrator
narrator/crown_hollow_where_the_6aaed2b2.text: Crown Hollow. Where the Master once sat, two armies wait for the sun.

narrator/dawn_came_to_emberfall_3a15cf81.speaker: narrator
narrator/dawn_came_to_emberfall_3a15cf81.text: Dawn came to Emberfall, and so did the Emberguard.

narrator/dawn_came_up_over_260ffe77.speaker: narrator
narrator/dawn_came_up_over_260ffe77.text: Dawn came up over Lark Hill, and the wagons rolled on.

narrator/duskbarrow_the_city_of_b9659384.speaker: narrator
narrator/duskbarrow_the_city_of_b9659384.text: Duskbarrow. The city of the dead, where Malrik learned to read by tombstone light.

narrator/evenmead_the_last_green_cabba6e.speaker: narrator
narrator/evenmead_the_last_green_cabba6e.text: Evenmead. The last green country. By sundown, someone will own the ford.

narrator/far_away_three_apprentices_c4c4.speaker: narrator
narrator/far_away_three_apprentices_c4c4.text: Far away, three apprentices feel the crown wake up, and begin to worry.

narrator/fire_and_thunder_took_330f899d.speaker: narrator
narrator/fire_and_thunder_took_330f899d.text: Fire and thunder took the ridge, and the Bishop's winter melted away.

narrator/fire_is_at_war_9101ffca.speaker: narrator
narrator/fire_is_at_war_9101ffca.text: Fire is at war with Shadow, while Ice and Nature watch. Under the world, something is counting.

narrator/first_light_on_lark_8660f9a5.speaker: narrator
narrator/first_light_on_lark_8660f9a5.text: First light. On Lark Hill, Vessa found her wagons. She did not wait.

narrator/glasswater_mere_has_not_11b716c.speaker: narrator
narrator/glasswater_mere_has_not_11b716c.text: Glasswater Mere has not thawed in a hundred winters. Something at the bottom still shines.

narrator/nature_had_no_kingdom_ffec5004.speaker: narrator
narrator/nature_had_no_kingdom_ffec5004.text: Nature had no kingdom left, only seed. Fire had a border, and a frost fort sitting on it.

narrator/night_on_lark_hill_93cdfc64.speaker: narrator
narrator/night_on_lark_hill_93cdfc64.text: Night on Lark Hill. Two armies asleep in their armour, and one woman who never sleeps.

narrator/old_mossjaw_wakes_in_0ace1275.speaker: narrator
narrator/old_mossjaw_wakes_in_0ace1275.text: Old Mossjaw wakes in the Hollowfen, and he is hungry.

narrator/shadow_from_the_east_be71340a.speaker: narrator
narrator/shadow_from_the_east_be71340a.text: Shadow from the east, frost from the north. The two new friends close the vice.

narrator/the_door_held_the_a0cc4fc5.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_door_held_the_a0cc4fc5.text: The door held. The war went looking for open ground,

narrator/the_ford_fell_at_464edfdf.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_ford_fell_at_464edfdf.text: The ford fell at dusk. The golden tree still stood. Both hills called it a victory.

narrator/the_master_is_gone_e050d7b6.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_master_is_gone_e050d7b6.text: The Master is gone. His crown is not.

narrator/the_ridge_fell_to_caa48395.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_ridge_fell_to_caa48395.text: The ridge fell to Shadow. Torvald had heard the stone say his name. He did not forget it.

narrator/the_salt_road_runs_e832db6b.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_salt_road_runs_e832db6b.text: The Salt Road runs from Emberfall to the sea. Everything on it has a price, even the road.

narrator/the_sighing_wood_has_86f071de.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sighing_wood_has_86f071de.text: The Sighing Wood has kept out of every quarrel for a hundred years. Today two armies walked in.

narrator/the_sighing_wood_kept_058db674.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sighing_wood_kept_058db674.text: The Sighing Wood kept out of every quarrel for a century. Now it is ash, and the ash is frozen.

narrator/the_sunrise_road_the_27a4fd73.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_sunrise_road_the_27a4fd73.text: The Sunrise Road. The Master cut it before the kingdoms had names. No one has walked it since.

narrator/the_vigils_burned_again_c72c8aa.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_vigils_burned_again_c72c8aa.text: The vigils burned again in Duskbarrow. In the Bishop's pocket, the stone kept count.

narrator/the_westwatch_fire_rises_d7e80c.speaker: narrator
narrator/the_westwatch_fire_rises_d7e80c.text: The Westwatch fire rises. Riders who remember the old kingdom ride to meet it.

narrator/three_days_later_malrik_fc11b25.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_days_later_malrik_fc11b25.text: Three days later. Malrik came back from Duskbarrow to a ridge that smelled of thunder.

narrator/three_flames_answer_the_69a7547.speaker: narrator
narrator/three_flames_answer_the_69a7547.text: Three flames answer. The seal cracks, and the old wardens wake up grumpy.

narrator/two_barrows_sleep_the_beebc31e.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_barrows_sleep_the_beebc31e.text: Two barrows sleep. The stone does not like the quiet.

narrator/two_kingdoms_on_one_59a004bb.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_kingdoms_on_one_59a004bb.text: Two kingdoms on one bank, two across the water. Now it is a real war.

narrator/two_relics_answer_to_e03dc527.speaker: narrator
narrator/two_relics_answer_to_e03dc527.text: Two relics answer to fire. In the north, Ice watches, and says nothing.

narrator/under_the_roots_of_d20b9974.speaker: narrator
narrator/under_the_roots_of_d20b9974.text: Under the roots of the world, a door. And on the other side of it, the one who made it.

pell/a_bazaar_look_at_ecd96f30.speaker: pell
pell/a_bazaar_look_at_ecd96f30.text: A Bazaar! Look at it. Smell it. Now put wheels on something and send it somewhere far.

pell/a_war_terrible_wonderful_a6a5a036.speaker: pell
pell/a_war_terrible_wonderful_a6a5a036.text: A war! Terrible. Wonderful for business. Terrible.

pell/free_at_last_buy_f2b6c6c4.speaker: pell
pell/free_at_last_buy_f2b6c6c4.text: Free at last! Buy something, would you? Shadow soldiers are terrible customers. They never pay, they just loom.

pell/gold_your_first_gold_b6620284.speaker: pell
pell/gold_your_first_gold_b6620284.text: Gold! Your first gold. I'm not crying. It's the salt.

pell/last_stall_before_the_7f02c05c.speaker: pell
pell/last_stall_before_the_7f02c05c.text: Last stall before the end of the world! Everything must go. Including me, quickly.

pell/robbing_malriks_wagons_youre_38f381.speaker: pell
pell/robbing_malriks_wagons_youre_38f381.text: Robbing Malrik's wagons! You're a natural. I've never been prouder.

pell/rocks_become_gold_at_797e0200.speaker: pell
pell/rocks_become_gold_at_797e0200.text: Rocks become gold at a post, my queen. Gold becomes everything else. Trust a professional.

pell/they_took_the_tribute_28a7156d.speaker: pell
pell/they_took_the_tribute_28a7156d.text: They took the tribute! Get it back! That gold has my fingerprints on it!

pell/you_again_my_wheels_6ee99e5f.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_my_wheels_6ee99e5f.text: You again! My wheels froze to the road, so I suppose I'm open. Take this, it's on the house. The house is frozen too.

pell/you_again_the_fire_a57ffab3.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_the_fire_a57ffab3.text: You again! The fire one. Last time you let me out of a cage. Today I let you into a market.

pell/you_again_you_left_159865ec.speaker: pell
pell/you_again_you_left_159865ec.text: You again! You left me in that cage, you know. I escaped. On my own. Thank you for asking.

reveler/to_vessa_to_the_79ccdcb8.speaker: reveler
reveler/to_vessa_to_the_79ccdcb8.text: To Vessa! To the Ember Queen!

shade/bishop_the_barrows_are_629fbcc7.speaker: shade
shade/bishop_the_barrows_are_629fbcc7.text: Bishop. The barrows are stirring. The living are in the Great Crypt. All of them.

shade/duskbarrow_bishop_the_barrow_e07a6.speaker: shade
shade/duskbarrow_bishop_the_barrow_e07a6.text: Duskbarrow, Bishop. The barrow candles have gone out. The dead are walking.

shade/the_crypt_doors_are_298b8a15.speaker: shade
shade/the_crypt_doors_are_298b8a15.text: The crypt doors are cracking! The families are inside!

shade/the_crypt_is_open_2f2d0565.speaker: shade
shade/the_crypt_is_open_2f2d0565.text: The crypt is open... the dead are among the living!

shade/the_keep_sleeps_so_dac3a4b3.speaker: shade
shade/the_keep_sleeps_so_dac3a4b3.text: The keep sleeps. So should you.

shade/the_paupers_field_and_bd671f67.speaker: shade
shade/the_paupers_field_and_bd671f67.text: The Pauper's Field and the Bishops' Rest are open! Everything is walking!

shade/they_will_not_see_3a1ecd2d.speaker: shade
shade/they_will_not_see_3a1ecd2d.text: They will not see me coming.

torvald/every_dusk_the_old_c9948c31.speaker: torvald
torvald/every_dusk_the_old_c9948c31.text: Every dusk the old man walks down to the river and looks at us. Then he walks away.

torvald/go_i_will_keep_2ee86eee.speaker: torvald
torvald/go_i_will_keep_2ee86eee.text: Go. I will keep your ridge cold.

torvald/i_gave_the_wood_952c4f0b.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_gave_the_wood_952c4f0b.text: I gave the wood one winter. I can give it another.

torvald/i_heard_it_ask_1c2809dd.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_heard_it_ask_1c2809dd.text: I heard it ask. I did not hear him say no.

torvald/i_told_malrik_no_ce3f4de1.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_told_malrik_no_ce3f4de1.text: I told Malrik no, once. Then I watched you carry three keys toward the Hollow.

torvald/i_will_hold_the_1a672c55.speaker: torvald
torvald/i_will_hold_the_1a672c55.text: I will hold the north stair, Bishop. Do what you came to do, and quickly.

torvald/malrik_that_light_in_7381eb71.speaker: torvald
torvald/malrik_that_light_in_7381eb71.text: Malrik. That light in your hand. It moved before you did.

torvald/malrik_your_hand_is_e854d9e4.speaker: torvald
torvald/malrik_your_hand_is_e854d9e4.text: Malrik. Your hand is shaking. Is that you, or the stone?

torvald/no_i_dont_think_a562d51a.speaker: torvald
torvald/no_i_dont_think_a562d51a.text: No. I don't think you can.

torvald/not_yet_i_think_c4a69176.speaker: torvald
torvald/not_yet_i_think_c4a69176.text: Not yet. I think he was waiting for you. He is polite like that.

torvald/now_bishop_before_her_572d46a7.speaker: torvald
torvald/now_bishop_before_her_572d46a7.text: Now, Bishop. Before her roots take hold.

torvald/now_bishop_before_the_eb24f578.speaker: torvald
torvald/now_bishop_before_the_eb24f578.text: Now, Bishop. Before the spring remembers itself.

torvald/quickly_then_before_that_5a5af6a.speaker: torvald
torvald/quickly_then_before_that_5a5af6a.text: Quickly, then. Before that stone in your pocket finishes its sentence.

torvald/run_little_ember_every_4483f6f4.speaker: torvald
torvald/run_little_ember_every_4483f6f4.text: Run, little ember. Every relic you carry makes the Hollow hungrier. You will see.

torvald/so_be_it_my_eab50021.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_be_it_my_eab50021.text: So be it. My lake will see you out. Slowly.

torvald/so_the_little_ember_6f0f8efc.speaker: torvald
torvald/so_the_little_ember_6f0f8efc.text: So the little ember comes to warm the wood. You are late, child. Winter got here first.

torvald/spring_is_stubborn_so_8bfa6d1b.speaker: torvald
torvald/spring_is_stubborn_so_8bfa6d1b.text: Spring is stubborn. So is winter. This is not over, child.

torvald/that_ice_has_kept_b5c388c1.speaker: torvald
torvald/that_ice_has_kept_b5c388c1.text: That ice has kept a secret for a hundred winters, ember. Think before you melt it.

torvald/they_have_a_watch_517c05e2.speaker: torvald
torvald/they_have_a_watch_517c05e2.text: They have a watch. Take it back, or the ridge goes with it.

torvald/this_bank_is_mine_e541fbea.speaker: torvald
torvald/this_bank_is_mine_e541fbea.text: This bank is mine until the thaw, child. The thaw is a long way off.

torvald/this_is_not_what_4e569918.speaker: torvald
torvald/this_is_not_what_4e569918.text: This is not what you promised, Bishop. You said a door. Not a jailer.

torvald/two_banners_on_one_acfda80e.speaker: torvald
torvald/two_banners_on_one_acfda80e.text: Two banners on one bank. Malrik, I begin to see why you feared her.

torvald/two_children_fighting_on_724fb69.speaker: torvald
torvald/two_children_fighting_on_724fb69.text: Two children, fighting on my lake. Finish it quickly, and leave my ice alone.

torvald/what_did_it_cost_62e071ef.speaker: torvald
torvald/what_did_it_cost_62e071ef.text: What did it cost you, Malrik? In Duskbarrow.

torvald/you_send_a_knife_bdde2636.speaker: torvald
torvald/you_send_a_knife_bdde2636.text: You send a knife at farmers' carts, Malrik.

torvald/your_shadows_are_thorough_57f487.speaker: torvald
torvald/your_shadows_are_thorough_57f487.text: Your shadows are thorough, Malrik. I am not certain that is a compliment.

unit_bleakbow/whisper_i_see_them_b37c818.speaker: unit_bleakbow
unit_bleakbow/whisper_i_see_them_b37c818.text: [whisper] I see them. They don't see me.

unit_bloomtender/i_would_rather_heal_192.speaker: unit_bloomtender
unit_bloomtender/i_would_rather_heal_192.text: I would rather heal, but fine.

unit_cinder_arbalest/line_them_up_one_d6.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
unit_cinder_arbalest/line_them_up_one_d6.text: Line them up. One bolt, two holes.

unit_flame_guard/eccomi_il_pi_forte_a295.speaker: unit_flame_guard
unit_flame_guard/eccomi_il_pi_forte_a295.text: Eccomi. Il più forte è arrivato.

unit_flame_guard/venite_qui_se_avete_73c.speaker: unit_flame_guard
unit_flame_guard/venite_qui_se_avete_73c.text: Venite qui, se avete il coraggio!

unit_hoarlight_magebow/a_needle_of_frost.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
unit_hoarlight_magebow/a_needle_of_frost.text: A needle of frost for you.

unit_nightblood_reaver/line_83b34597.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
unit_nightblood_reaver/line_83b34597.text: 您过奖了，我只是个小兵。

unit_nightbolt/a_bolt_of_night_909f5ca8.speaker: unit_nightbolt
unit_nightbolt/a_bolt_of_night_909f5ca8.text: A bolt of night, at your word.

unit_rimeshield/all_voy_con_la_049f00e8.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/all_voy_con_la_049f00e8.text: Allá voy, con la frente en alto.

unit_rimeshield/mi_escudo_jam_s_da99281c.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/mi_escudo_jam_s_da99281c.text: Mi escudo jamás se ha rendido.

unit_rimeshield/s_el_escudo_m_e192d010.speaker: unit_rimeshield
unit_rimeshield/s_el_escudo_m_e192d010.text: ¿Sí? El escudo más noble del norte.

unit_shadow_knight/my_blade_is_sworn_052.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
unit_shadow_knight/my_blade_is_sworn_052.text: My blade is sworn to Malrik.

unit_shardguard/where_i_walk_the_b31beda.speaker: unit_shardguard
unit_shardguard/where_i_walk_the_b31beda.text: Where I walk, the ice holds.

unit_stormbottle_genie/out_of_the_bottle.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
unit_stormbottle_genie/out_of_the_bottle.text: Out of the bottle at last!

unit_thornling/fine_there_better_be_5766.speaker: unit_thornling
unit_thornling/fine_there_better_be_5766.text: Fine. There better be a fight there.

unit_thornling/you_looking_at_me_14898f1.speaker: unit_thornling
unit_thornling/you_looking_at_me_14898f1.text: You looking at me? Let's go, then.

vessa/a_dragon_an_actual_a6bba5a9.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_dragon_an_actual_a6bba5a9.text: A dragon! An actual dragon! Vey, I have a DRAGON.

vessa/a_forge_he_built_2c3528a5.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_forge_he_built_2c3528a5.text: A forge. He built forges down here? What was he making?

vessa/a_heart_made_of_7feaee8e.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_heart_made_of_7feaee8e.text: A heart made of roots, pumping green. Only Ysolde would grow a thing like that.

vessa/a_hundred_winters_of_5f881f3c.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_hundred_winters_of_5f881f3c.text: A hundred winters of ice, and it took me one afternoon. Somebody write that down.

vessa/a_tollbooth_you_built_1747d5af.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_tollbooth_you_built_1747d5af.text: A tollbooth. You built a tollbooth. That is the most Malrik thing you've ever done.

vessa/a_tree_im_opening_9b332d04.speaker: vessa
vessa/a_tree_im_opening_9b332d04.text: A tree. I'm opening a tree. Before HE does.

vessa/an_ember_crown_in_b9772779.speaker: vessa
vessa/an_ember_crown_in_b9772779.text: An Ember Crown, in a place called Emberfall. Nobody said it was left for me. Nobody said it wasn't.

vessa/bettany_i_thought_your_87aa3e78.speaker: vessa
vessa/bettany_i_thought_your_87aa3e78.text: Bettany? I thought your tavern burned down.

vessa/both_fords_vey_we_93963db8.speaker: vessa
vessa/both_fords_vey_we_93963db8.text: Both fords, Vey! We pinch him!

vessa/but_her_people_have_6f60fcc0.speaker: vessa
vessa/but_her_people_have_6f60fcc0.text: But her people have no one else. I need you. All of you.

vessa/come_and_take_them_b14d71f4.speaker: vessa
vessa/come_and_take_them_b14d71f4.text: Come and take them, Bishop. You owe me for Emberfall. And for Vey.

vessa/crown_orb_signet_lets_09e0dc3a.speaker: vessa
vessa/crown_orb_signet_lets_09e0dc3a.text: Crown, orb, signet. Let's see what you do together.

vessa/deal_and_next_time_1de98e38.speaker: vessa
vessa/deal_and_next_time_1de98e38.text: Deal. And next time, I'll leave your trees alone.

vessa/dogs_why_is_it_27fe2d74.speaker: vessa
vessa/dogs_why_is_it_27fe2d74.text: Dogs! Why is it always dogs?

vessa/emberguard_on_your_feet_70d3aa58.speaker: vessa
vessa/emberguard_on_your_feet_70d3aa58.text: Emberguard, on your feet! Stamp your boots until you can feel your toes.

vessa/every_stone_lit_ill_385d4cee.speaker: vessa
vessa/every_stone_lit_ill_385d4cee.text: Every stone lit. I'll admit it, the Master had good taste in caves.

vessa/everyone_back_to_the_ec47ce27.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_back_to_the_ec47ce27.text: Everyone, back to the keep! BACK!

vessa/everyone_on_the_door_cfef952b.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_on_the_door_cfef952b.text: Everyone on the door! Nobody touches it but us!

vessa/everyone_says_that_about_34c37e51.speaker: vessa
vessa/everyone_says_that_about_34c37e51.text: Everyone says that about the things I want. And if I leave it, Malrik takes it.

vessa/fire_and_frost_they_27662a3f.speaker: vessa
vessa/fire_and_frost_they_27662a3f.text: Fire AND frost. They didn't just burn it. They made sure it stayed dead.

vessa/five_seconds_i_can_399fb215.speaker: vessa
vessa/five_seconds_i_can_399fb215.text: Five seconds. I can hold anything for five seconds.

vessa/get_the_army_up_757c6437.speaker: vessa
vessa/get_the_army_up_757c6437.text: Get the army up. We take the crown today.

vessa/hes_not_dead_hes_6c6b7931.speaker: vessa
vessa/hes_not_dead_hes_6c6b7931.text: He's not dead, he's LATE. There's a difference!

vessa/hes_on_our_hill_97303674.speaker: vessa
vessa/hes_on_our_hill_97303674.text: He's on our hill. I'm not waiting for him to plant a flag.

vessa/his_thralls_are_draining_202d9662.speaker: vessa
vessa/his_thralls_are_draining_202d9662.text: His Thralls are draining the hearts. If he opens that tree first, I lose it.

vessa/hold_on_ysolde_fire_413040f1.speaker: vessa
vessa/hold_on_ysolde_fire_413040f1.text: Hold on, Ysolde. Fire is coming.

vessa/how_many_knives_does_e3d39bcd.speaker: vessa
vessa/how_many_knives_does_e3d39bcd.text: How many knives does one Bishop OWN?

vessa/huh_you_grow_a_4abd93de.speaker: vessa
vessa/huh_you_grow_a_4abd93de.text: Huh. You grow a castle out of a seed. I have to build mine out of rocks.

vessa/hush_i_know_that_22dfa6e3.speaker: vessa
vessa/hush_i_know_that_22dfa6e3.text: Hush! I know that smoke. Come out and finish what you started!

vessa/i_am_the_thaw_7ae66e54.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_am_the_thaw_7ae66e54.text: I AM the thaw, Torvald. I've been told I'm very warm.

vessa/i_had_ten_minutes_1ac055e8.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_had_ten_minutes_1ac055e8.text: I had ten minutes to practise running. Those pillars feed it. Break them all!

vessa/i_know_youre_tired_54835bf6.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_know_youre_tired_54835bf6.text: I know you're tired. I know we just won.

vessa/i_never_listen_i_640cee6b.speaker: vessa
vessa/i_never_listen_i_640cee6b.text: I never listen. I just show up.

vessa/im_here_for_the_10aceb62.speaker: vessa
vessa/im_here_for_the_10aceb62.text: I'm here for the crown, not a lecture. Fine. Both.

vessa/im_not_the_one_50cdda91.speaker: vessa
vessa/im_not_the_one_50cdda91.text: I'm not the one who's hurt, Captain.

vessa/it_answered_the_door_6900defa.speaker: vessa
vessa/it_answered_the_door_6900defa.text: It answered! The Door hit it! He's helping us!

vessa/its_so_dark_good_1ba97a95.speaker: vessa
vessa/its_so_dark_good_1ba97a95.text: It's so dark. Good thing I'm the brightest person I know.

vessa/its_warm_vey_the_239e20da.speaker: vessa
vessa/its_warm_vey_the_239e20da.text: It's warm. Vey, the door is WARM. Something's on the other side.

vessa/ive_been_stabbed_one_607cfa86.speaker: vessa
vessa/ive_been_stabbed_one_607cfa86.text: I've been stabbed ONE time and I already hate it.

vessa/malrik_you_brought_a_fe9dd213.speaker: vessa
vessa/malrik_you_brought_a_fe9dd213.text: Malrik! You brought a whole winter to a picnic.

vessa/malrik_you_sent_the_76c312b3.speaker: vessa
vessa/malrik_you_sent_the_76c312b3.text: MALRIK! You sent the knife-woman into my camp AGAIN?

vessa/malriks_already_here_of_8b72df0b.speaker: vessa
vessa/malriks_already_here_of_8b72df0b.text: Malrik's already here. Of course he is. Then I'll borrow a forest.

vessa/malriks_diggers_on_torvalds_551beb.speaker: vessa
vessa/malriks_diggers_on_torvalds_551beb.text: Malrik's diggers on Torvald's lake. Torvald must be thrilled.

vessa/master_master_im_here_f3abe572.speaker: vessa
vessa/master_master_im_here_f3abe572.text: Master?! Master, I'm here! I'm right here!

vessa/mother_hush_last_time_1e75e80d.speaker: vessa
vessa/mother_hush_last_time_1e75e80d.text: Mother Hush. Last time you ran. Want to try running a second time?

vessa/mother_hush_you_missed_55328f83.speaker: vessa
vessa/mother_hush_you_missed_55328f83.text: Mother Hush. You missed me once. I'd hate for you to get out of practice.

vessa/nobody_stays_faded_around_83860285.speaker: vessa
vessa/nobody_stays_faded_around_83860285.text: Nobody stays faded around here. Ask Vey.

vessa/not_the_keep_i_dfa556d1.speaker: vessa
vessa/not_the_keep_i_dfa556d1.text: Not the keep! I JUST had it redecorated!

vessa/now_you_want_to_9878e199.speaker: vessa
vessa/now_you_want_to_9878e199.text: NOW you want to talk? Your wood tried to eat me.

vessa/one_dance_then_im_faec23ce.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_dance_then_im_faec23ce.text: One dance. Then I'm eating everything.

vessa/one_gate_down_stone_e771f8b3.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_gate_down_stone_e771f8b3.text: One gate down. Stone breaks. Good to know.

vessa/one_lit_malrik_you_c51368de.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_lit_malrik_you_c51368de.text: One lit. Malrik, you still dress like a funeral that got lost on the way.

vessa/one_seal_see_vey_b0114f79.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_seal_see_vey_b0114f79.text: One seal! See, Vey? I can be patient. For four seconds at a time.

vessa/one_time_i_set_ba75a181.speaker: vessa
vessa/one_time_i_set_ba75a181.text: One time. I set ONE tree on fire, one time.

vessa/ow_fine_back_in_2928674b.speaker: vessa
vessa/ow_fine_back_in_2928674b.text: Ow! Fine! Back in a minute!

vessa/pell_keep_the_bazaar_165f393f.speaker: vessa
vessa/pell_keep_the_bazaar_165f393f.text: Pell, keep the Bazaar running. Fire just learned what gold is for.

vessa/pells_cart_and_no_cf72e0e9.speaker: vessa
vessa/pells_cart_and_no_cf72e0e9.text: Pell's cart, and no Pell. Maybe I should have opened that cage. Well. Finders keepers.

vessa/rimeholds_down_torvald_you_d0b8e09.speaker: vessa
vessa/rimeholds_down_torvald_you_d0b8e09.text: Rimehold's down. Torvald, you left your fort on my bank. I put it back.

vessa/sellswords_who_wont_take_b3c0d8bb.speaker: vessa
vessa/sellswords_who_wont_take_b3c0d8bb.text: Sellswords who won't take orders. Perfect. I'll pay them to want what I want.

vessa/shades_in_the_ashes_aa11432f.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_ashes_aa11432f.text: Shades in the ashes. Malrik never could resist a funeral.

vessa/shades_in_the_dark_b70f5c56.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_dark_b70f5c56.text: Shades, in the dark. Of course. They never pick a nice, sunny cave.

vessa/shades_in_the_dark_c3fe4357.speaker: vessa
vessa/shades_in_the_dark_c3fe4357.text: Shades in the dark. I know that smoke. She ran from me once.

vessa/six_wagons_of_gold_39588153.speaker: vessa
vessa/six_wagons_of_gold_39588153.text: Six wagons of gold. I don't own one wagon of gold. I own a lot of rocks. Shiny ones.

vessa/so_you_picked_the_820c0495.speaker: vessa
vessa/so_you_picked_the_820c0495.text: So you picked the man who sends knives at night. Great judgement, Torvald.

vessa/somebody_tell_the_sellswords_1fc73.speaker: vessa
vessa/somebody_tell_the_sellswords_1fc73.text: Somebody tell the sellswords their bounty's ready. And tell the bear I'm sorry.

vessa/stables_javelins_on_horsebac_1defe.speaker: vessa
vessa/stables_javelins_on_horsebac_1defe.text: Stables! Javelins on horseback. Sir Crackle will have to wait for a saddle.

vessa/tell_malrik_he_still_28e49ca8.speaker: vessa
vessa/tell_malrik_he_still_28e49ca8.text: Tell Malrik... he still dresses like a funeral.

vessa/tell_the_others_i_62fd53ca.speaker: vessa
vessa/tell_the_others_i_62fd53ca.text: Tell the others... I was winning.

vessa/that_voice_again_id_d898ed30.speaker: vessa
vessa/that_voice_again_id_d898ed30.text: That voice again. I'd hoped we buried you.

vessa/thats_it_thats_the_0a1adf3f.speaker: vessa
vessa/thats_it_thats_the_0a1adf3f.text: That's it. That's the door. Vey, he's right there. Under my feet.

vessa/thats_one_hall_torvald_68528ecf.speaker: vessa
vessa/thats_one_hall_torvald_68528ecf.text: That's one hall Torvald won't need to keep cold any more.

vessa/the_beacons_lit_vey_b53dba26.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_beacons_lit_vey_b53dba26.text: The beacon's lit. Vey! You said call. I'm calling!

vessa/the_citadels_up_vey_05049ab8.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_citadels_up_vey_05049ab8.text: The Citadel's up. Vey, the storm can come any time now. Now would be good.

vessa/the_ground_is_breathing_da7bc5fe.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_ground_is_breathing_da7bc5fe.text: The ground is breathing. That can't be good.

vessa/the_hearths_lit_ashby_fdfe23ff.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_hearths_lit_ashby_fdfe23ff.text: The hearth's lit. Ashby, it's yours. Make me things that hit harder.

vessa/the_watch_fires_are_67de4a2b.speaker: vessa
vessa/the_watch_fires_are_67de4a2b.text: The watch fires are out. All of them.

vessa/then_help_me_stop_72fbf18f.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_help_me_stop_72fbf18f.text: Then help me stop it. Please.

vessa/then_ill_be_standing_94087c96.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_ill_be_standing_94087c96.text: Then I'll be standing right where it happens.

vessa/then_its_in_the_02a82f6a.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_its_in_the_02a82f6a.text: Then it's in the right hands. I throw fire at ALL my problems.

vessa/then_lets_give_him_bbd6c834.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_lets_give_him_bbd6c834.text: Then let's give him something to push with. Door! Light! NOW!

vessa/then_we_go_faster_c1e4b702.speaker: vessa
vessa/then_we_go_faster_c1e4b702.text: Then we go faster. Wardens, with me. We're going to fetch the Master.

vessa/theres_a_warden_in_038e717a.speaker: vessa
vessa/theres_a_warden_in_038e717a.text: There's a Warden in the wall. Asleep. Vey, the last ones I met tried to crush me.

vessa/thin_ice_ha_i_9764e3a3.speaker: vessa
vessa/thin_ice_ha_i_9764e3a3.text: Thin ice! Ha! I am absolutely doing that again.

vessa/three_braziers_one_seal_f3a00131.speaker: vessa
vessa/three_braziers_one_seal_f3a00131.text: Three braziers, one seal. I've been lighting things since before I could talk.

vessa/three_trees_i_can_c9a739b2.speaker: vessa
vessa/three_trees_i_can_c9a739b2.text: Three trees? I can do three trees. Torvald brought a whole fort. That one's mine.

vessa/tolls_paid_in_fire_a6752191.speaker: vessa
vessa/tolls_paid_in_fire_a6752191.text: Toll's paid. In fire. Keep the change.

vessa/too_cold_should_have_57dc9c09.speaker: vessa
vessa/too_cold_should_have_57dc9c09.text: Too... cold... should have... brought a coat...

vessa/twelve_years_late_then_38462db8.speaker: vessa
vessa/twelve_years_late_then_38462db8.text: Twelve years late, then twelve hours. You're improving.

vessa/two_down_keep_hitting_5bc0db1c.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_down_keep_hitting_5bc0db1c.text: Two down. Keep hitting the glowing parts. It's always the glowing parts.

vessa/two_of_you_one_79a9ed64.speaker: vessa
vessa/two_of_you_one_79a9ed64.text: Two of you, one of me. Sounds fair. For me.

vessa/vey_get_up_were_b41efc64.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_get_up_were_b41efc64.text: Vey! Get up! We're not done!

vessa/vey_the_citadels_lit_9f2ff849.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_the_citadels_lit_9f2ff849.text: Vey, the Citadel's lit. The stair can wait. I've got thieves.

vessa/vey_the_light_its_9dc387bd.speaker: vessa
vessa/vey_the_light_its_9dc387bd.text: Vey... the light... it's going out...

vessa/what_do_they_even_f2911967.speaker: vessa
vessa/what_do_they_even_f2911967.text: What do they even want all this gold for?

vessa/who_walks_the_wall_45dd4c19.speaker: vessa
vessa/who_walks_the_wall_45dd4c19.text: Who walks the wall at this hour?

vessa/you_always_said_fire_704521b4.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_always_said_fire_704521b4.text: You always said fire was the problem, Ysolde. Today it's the answer.

vessa/you_are_a_long_e1ae8fe0.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_are_a_long_e1ae8fe0.text: You are a long way from the dark, shade.

vessa/you_just_got_back_99eb210d.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_just_got_back_99eb210d.text: You just got back, and you're leaving again? You're lucky I'm busy.

vessa/you_rebuilt_it_you_97221396.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_rebuilt_it_you_97221396.text: You rebuilt it?! You rebuilt the tollbooth?

vessa/you_want_me_come_5ba1f2f4.speaker: vessa
vessa/you_want_me_come_5ba1f2f4.text: You want me? Come and get me. ALL of you.

vessa/youre_going_to_explain_b65d26f7.speaker: vessa
vessa/youre_going_to_explain_b65d26f7.text: You're going to explain the lightning.

vessa/ysolde_i_came_i_540a231c.speaker: vessa
vessa/ysolde_i_came_i_540a231c.text: Ysolde... I came. I really came...

vey/and_you_still_miss_b87c5062.speaker: vey
vey/and_you_still_miss_b87c5062.text: And you still miss, knife-woman. Every single time.

vey/bishop_not_one_alarm_2e401aa6.speaker: vey
vey/bishop_not_one_alarm_2e401aa6.text: Bishop! Not one alarm, that night. Your knife is getting better. So am I.

vey/bishop_you_sent_your_3da4100f.speaker: vey
vey/bishop_you_sent_your_3da4100f.text: Bishop! You sent your knife into my girl's camp twice now. I've come to return the favour.

vey/eight_of_his_wardens_c5861d21.speaker: vey
vey/eight_of_his_wardens_c5861d21.text: Eight of his Wardens, awake for you. He'd have liked that.

vey/especially_malrik_he_always_2e2ac84d.speaker: vey
vey/especially_malrik_he_always_2e2ac84d.text: Especially Malrik. He always said that.

vey/feel_that_hes_pushing_8daca2f9.speaker: vey
vey/feel_that_hes_pushing_8daca2f9.text: Feel that? He's pushing back from below. The spark first, Vessa. Then the storm.

vey/first_time_youve_called_d344ca7e.speaker: vey
vey/first_time_youve_called_d344ca7e.text: First time you've called me in twelve years, girl. I came running.

vey/four_seals_wake_them_904df50c.speaker: vey
vey/four_seals_wake_them_904df50c.text: Four seals. Wake them with the relics and the door stands. Let Malrik break them and it falls.

vey/good_light_pushes_back_e5c39d8b.speaker: vey
vey/good_light_pushes_back_e5c39d8b.text: Good. Light pushes back the dark. Always has.

vey/here_hand_on_the_13ad5858.speaker: vey
vey/here_hand_on_the_13ad5858.text: Here. Hand on the sun, girl. I'll give it the storm. Hold it with me.

vey/hes_down_there_i_20c63292.speaker: vey
vey/hes_down_there_i_20c63292.text: He's down there. I can feel him. And he's tired, girl. So very tired.

vey/hes_holding_it_up_21f44ae3.speaker: vey
vey/hes_holding_it_up_21f44ae3.text: He's holding it up with the shard! Cut the line, girl! Get to Malrik!

vey/i_felled_a_mountain_227f8c5f.speaker: vey
vey/i_felled_a_mountain_227f8c5f.text: I felled a mountain yesterday, girl. I'll clap.

vey/i_know_those_knives_db6b10ba.speaker: vey
vey/i_know_those_knives_db6b10ba.text: I know those knives. Not in my girl's camp. Not twice.

vey/ill_ride_the_north_81a39f19.speaker: vey
vey/ill_ride_the_north_81a39f19.text: I'll ride the north road and see what Torvald brought. Light the beacon when you want the storm.

vey/ill_ride_to_emberfall_1ffd60eb.speaker: vey
vey/ill_ride_to_emberfall_1ffd60eb.text: I'll ride to Emberfall and find the old stair. Pay the hunters, then call me.

vey/just_resting_my_knees_d19fc930.speaker: vey
vey/just_resting_my_knees_d19fc930.text: Just resting my knees. Keep turning that key!

vey/kindle_it_again_girl_7cf9b0b2.speaker: vey
vey/kindle_it_again_girl_7cf9b0b2.text: Kindle it again, girl. The relics are stronger than his pebble. If you hold them.

vey/last_storm_ive_got_6396a514.speaker: vey
vey/last_storm_ive_got_6396a514.text: Last storm I've got, Bishop. Let's see what you've got.

vey/no_knives_at_our_373a8a0e.speaker: vey
vey/no_knives_at_our_373a8a0e.text: No knives at our backs tonight. Hush is still licking her wounds. Good.

vey/obrens_wardens_they_guarded_84edb443.speaker: vey
vey/obrens_wardens_they_guarded_84edb443.text: Obren's Wardens. They guarded this door before he turned. Now they guard nothing.

vey/off_my_hill_well_545b1a48.speaker: vey
vey/off_my_hill_well_545b1a48.text: Off my hill. Well. Your hill. For now.

vey/so_you_do_point_b04c4a82.speaker: vey
vey/so_you_do_point_b04c4a82.text: So you do. Point it at the big statue, and try not to name it.

vey/stay_behind_my_sword_686025ff.speaker: vey
vey/stay_behind_my_sword_686025ff.text: Stay behind my sword, girl. Knives hate a long reach.

vey/stay_close_girl_whatever_28b0bbfa.speaker: vey
vey/stay_close_girl_whatever_28b0bbfa.text: Stay close, girl. Whatever it throws at you, I'll ground it.

vey/stay_close_to_the_278dca0e.speaker: vey
vey/stay_close_to_the_278dca0e.text: Stay close to the light, girl. Down here the dark has teeth.

vey/sunfoots_burning_back_to_9133059e.speaker: vey
vey/sunfoots_burning_back_to_9133059e.text: Sunfoot's burning! Back to the stair, girl, now!

vey/sunstones_he_set_them_9039deca.speaker: vey
vey/sunstones_he_set_them_9039deca.text: Sunstones. He set them for the Wardens, so they'd always see him coming home.

vey/thats_enough_my_storm_09504456.speaker: vey
vey/thats_enough_my_storm_09504456.text: That's enough. My storm is borrowed, and I've spent the loan.

vey/the_spark_first_girl_92374f56.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_first_girl_92374f56.text: The spark first, girl. Then the storm.

vey/the_spark_first_then_4ed91055.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_first_then_4ed91055.text: The spark first. Then the storm!

vey/the_spark_was_yours_eb5573d9.speaker: vey
vey/the_spark_was_yours_eb5573d9.text: The spark was yours, Vessa. NOW the storm!

vey/theyre_throwing_everything_a_428dbc7.speaker: vey
vey/theyre_throwing_everything_a_428dbc7.text: They're throwing everything at the forge. Hold the light, and they break on it.

vey/thieves_and_a_toll_e8839ce7.speaker: vey
vey/thieves_and_a_toll_e8839ce7.text: Thieves AND a toll? Girl, you do know how to throw a party.

vey/those_were_obrens_woken_c47618a0.speaker: vey
vey/those_were_obrens_woken_c47618a0.text: Those were Obren's, woken by Obren. These are the Master's. They know whose storm I carry.

vey/two_crafts_mastered_good_d0766f84.speaker: vey
vey/two_crafts_mastered_good_d0766f84.text: Two crafts mastered. Good. The gate won't open for a fool. Or so he told me.

vey/two_more_hours_girl_37d4d925.speaker: vey
vey/two_more_hours_girl_37d4d925.text: Two more hours, girl. Dawn always comes. It's the one thing it's good at.

vey/up_old_friend_your_5797117b.speaker: vey
vey/up_old_friend_your_5797117b.text: Up, old friend. Your master's walking again. Well. His sword is.

vey/wardens_doors_things_that_5710ed13.speaker: vey
vey/wardens_doors_things_that_5710ed13.text: Wardens. Doors. Things that hold. He was always better at holding than letting go.

vey/we_are_today_girl_582fb19a.speaker: vey
vey/we_are_today_girl_582fb19a.text: We are today, girl. Today the ridge is his.

vey/you_called_twice_in_a26e3dc2.speaker: vey
vey/you_called_twice_in_a26e3dc2.text: You called twice in two days. I'll start to think you missed me.

whisper/a_hundred_years_in_672f8d08.speaker: whisper
whisper/a_hundred_years_in_672f8d08.text: A hundred years in the dark. I had time to practise my entrance.

whisper/enough_i_will_walk_879d0ef8.speaker: whisper
whisper/enough_i_will_walk_879d0ef8.text: Enough. I will walk to your little fire and put it out myself.

whisper/forty_years_he_dug_ee3849b1.speaker: whisper
whisper/forty_years_he_dug_ee3849b1.text: Forty years he dug here. Let me give him a body.

whisper/half_yours_half_mine_c5f6dc26.speaker: whisper
whisper/half_yours_half_mine_c5f6dc26.text: Half yours, half mine. We share so nicely, you and I.

whisper/his_storm_impossible_that_28b979.speaker: whisper
whisper/his_storm_impossible_that_28b979.text: His storm? Impossible! That light should have faded a hundred years ago!

whisper/let_me_do_more_ecefa255.speaker: whisper
whisper/let_me_do_more_ecefa255.text: Let me do more than beat, Bishop. Let me help.

whisper/mine_hold_still_let_e4f6c8cf.speaker: whisper
whisper/mine_hold_still_let_e4f6c8cf.text: MINE. Hold still. Let me look out of your eyes.

whisper/not_sell_lend_you_9f118719.speaker: whisper
whisper/not_sell_lend_you_9f118719.text: Not sell. Lend. You will hardly notice the price.

whisper/so_much_green_bishop_f81412c3.speaker: whisper
whisper/so_much_green_bishop_f81412c3.text: So much green, Bishop. Let it grow red. I can help.

whisper/the_flag_falls_the_ebc91e55.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_flag_falls_the_ebc91e55.text: The flag falls. The tree is right there. Take it. TAKE it.

whisper/the_third_one_sleeps_0896192f.speaker: whisper
whisper/the_third_one_sleeps_0896192f.text: The third one sleeps in the old tree. Wake it before he does.

whisper/there_was_that_so_e2d226b3.speaker: whisper
whisper/there_was_that_so_e2d226b3.text: There. Was that so hard? Again, whenever you like.

whisper/they_are_mine_now_4646b8ba.speaker: whisper
whisper/they_are_mine_now_4646b8ba.text: They are mine now, Bishop. Ask me nicely, and they kneel.

whisper/this_body_cracks_no_d01072ed.speaker: whisper
whisper/this_body_cracks_no_d01072ed.text: This body... cracks... No matter. Stone is patient.

whisper/three_thank_you_little_e9a06c0c.speaker: whisper
whisper/three_thank_you_little_e9a06c0c.text: Three. Thank you, little ember. I'll take it from here.

whisper/torvald_old_frost_you_15088ea0.speaker: whisper
whisper/torvald_old_frost_you_15088ea0.text: Torvald. Old frost. You feel it too. Join us, and nothing will ever melt.

whisper/wake_my_jailer_the_655df615.speaker: whisper
whisper/wake_my_jailer_the_655df615.text: Wake, my jailer. The door was always mine to open.

whisper/wake_my_masons_the_a7733422.speaker: whisper
whisper/wake_my_masons_the_a7733422.text: Wake, my masons. The Bishop's hand carries my heart. Obey it.

whisper/yes_come_both_of_b42e2981.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_come_both_of_b42e2981.text: Yes. Come, both of you. Fight on my roof.

whisper/yes_fight_every_fallen_4ee563a9.speaker: whisper
whisper/yes_fight_every_fallen_4ee563a9.text: Yes. Fight. Every fallen soldier is a step on my stair.

whisper/your_father_dug_these_207a3691.speaker: whisper
whisper/your_father_dug_these_207a3691.text: Your father dug these graves, Bishop. Shall I show you what I built from his work?

ysolde/a_tall_man_with_160c2abd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/a_tall_man_with_160c2abd.text: A tall man with a burning hem found me coaxing a sapling through the frost.

ysolde/but_when_your_war_2ad722b8.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/but_when_your_war_2ad722b8.text: But when your war comes for my wood, and it will, remember that I warned you both.

ysolde/every_root_on_this_a33e3782.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/every_root_on_this_a33e3782.text: Every root on this hill knows your name now. That is not a kindness.

ysolde/fire_and_shadow_burning_c74f3969.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/fire_and_shadow_burning_c74f3969.text: Fire and Shadow, burning my wood for a trinket. I will remember you both.

ysolde/he_said_show_me_79d79140.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/he_said_show_me_79d79140.text: He said: show me again. So I did, for twenty years, until he was gone.

ysolde/i_knelt_in_the_143cbc56.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_knelt_in_the_143cbc56.text: I knelt in the black, and I waited. Something green came up. It always does.

ysolde/i_warned_you_you_111da083.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_warned_you_you_111da083.text: I warned you. You didn't listen. Neither did he.

ysolde/i_was_born_on_fbe13b97.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/i_was_born_on_fbe13b97.text: I was born on that hill, the year nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.

ysolde/in_spring_it_came_67120205.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/in_spring_it_came_67120205.text: In spring it came up green. I have never forgotten how that felt.

ysolde/last_winter_they_burned_e017cf01.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/last_winter_they_burned_e017cf01.text: Last winter they burned my wood and froze the ashes. My army with it.

ysolde/let_them_come_cut_d956830a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/let_them_come_cut_d956830a.text: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.

ysolde/malrik_stands_up_there_5121c046.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_stands_up_there_5121c046.text: Malrik stands up there with his candle, his stone, and Torvald's winter.

ysolde/malrik_tells_his_life_52243579.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_tells_his_life_52243579.text: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds. Mine is a list of winters.

ysolde/malrik_you_burned_my_54c71dfd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/malrik_you_burned_my_54c71dfd.text: Malrik. You burned my people. You will not have their seed.

ysolde/my_mother_buried_seed_b7d7b32b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/my_mother_buried_seed_b7d7b32b.text: My mother buried seed in the snow. The village laughed. I watched it sleep.

ysolde/my_wood_tries_to_b8352a5f.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/my_wood_tries_to_b8352a5f.text: My wood tries to eat everyone. It's very fair.

ysolde/point_and_i_will_b24221fa.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/point_and_i_will_b24221fa.text: Point, and I will go. I am done waiting for wars to pass my wood by.

ysolde/put_three_together_near_fc54bb92.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/put_three_together_near_fc54bb92.text: Put three together near the Hollow and the door opens.

ysolde/stop_both_of_you_3ddd216b.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/stop_both_of_you_3ddd216b.text: Stop, both of you! You don't know what you're opening!

ysolde/that_is_my_strength_7a8a1ecc.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/that_is_my_strength_7a8a1ecc.text: That is my strength. I come back. Every spring. Every time.

ysolde/that_water_is_older_115ce9a6.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/that_water_is_older_115ce9a6.text: That water is older than all four of us. Get out of it.

ysolde/the_east_seal_is_8134f5f3.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_east_seal_is_8134f5f3.text: The east seal is mine. Hold the west, Vessa. We have done this before.

ysolde/the_line_is_cut_c1ceb75a.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_line_is_cut_c1ceb75a.text: The line is cut! Now, before he crawls back!

ysolde/the_master_planted_this_049c4f15.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_master_planted_this_049c4f15.text: The Master planted this country with his own hands. He left it to me to keep.

ysolde/the_roots_are_cut_db452fb8.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/the_roots_are_cut_db452fb8.text: The roots are cut. All of them. I am sorry, Vessa.

ysolde/then_the_people_go_b065c387.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_the_people_go_b065c387.text: Then the people go south today. All of them. The road is safer than this hill.

ysolde/then_we_each_keep_a74df410.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/then_we_each_keep_a74df410.text: Then we each keep the other's. Fire and Nature, one front.

ysolde/they_call_me_soft_3535b2b2.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_call_me_soft_3535b2b2.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

ysolde/they_cut_it_then_e3d83435.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/they_cut_it_then_e3d83435.text: They cut it. Then we plant it again. That is the whole of my strength.

ysolde/this_one_i_can_d1112046.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/this_one_i_can_d1112046.text: This one I can do alone. Keep them off me, and do not set it on fire.

ysolde/those_relics_arent_a_9a6ba2bd.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/those_relics_arent_a_9a6ba2bd.text: Those relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.

ysolde/three_groves_along_your_6f6cb72e.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_groves_along_your_6f6cb72e.text: Three groves along your line, Vessa. Give me those, and I can give you a kingdom back.

ysolde/three_groves_enough_roots_ae16316.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_groves_enough_roots_ae16316.text: Three groves. Enough roots to stand on. Rise.

ysolde/three_stones_in_our_fdd6c9c0.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/three_stones_in_our_fdd6c9c0.text: Three stones in our hands. The land listens to whoever stands on it.

ysolde/torvald_is_on_my_7b99f0ec.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/torvald_is_on_my_7b99f0ec.text: Torvald is on my bridge with half of winter. I could use some fire.

ysolde/vessa_hold_the_crest_e7a2fa87.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/vessa_hold_the_crest_e7a2fa87.text: Vessa, hold the crest. Please. Just once, wait.

ysolde/you_came_i_told_5b75d752.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_came_i_told_5b75d752.text: You came. I told you to remember. I didn't think you'd listen.

ysolde/you_came_when_i_091e4eda.speaker: ysolde
ysolde/you_came_when_i_091e4eda.text: You came when I called, Vessa. Next time, I come when you do.
